summary.claim_boundary: Prospective 16-seed zero-slope-aware confirmation comparing causal online moving-kernel and fixed-source-chart natural paths at four frozen Fisher step radii 0.08, 0.04, 0.02, and 0.01. It measures response-retraction Fisher length, tangent residual, action convergence, and step-size scaling at one matched 20% endpoint. No post-hoc lambda-weighted composite action is tested. Newton response retraction approximates finite constrained motion. This is not an exact continuum horizontal lift, arbitrary-path result, GPT-2 transfer, stationarity theorem, or global variational law. The moving arm alone is required to have high log-log R-squared; the theoretically constant fixed arm is tested by absolute exponent and relative span, frozen before these new seeds are observed.
